notes: Primeira promoção do experimento, e a primeira com fixture de escrita medida: o piloto de 12/08 tinha quatro casos por braço morrendo no gate da bancada, que negava toda escrita.

O candidato é o formato em vigor. Ele ficou atrás: 36/50 contra 41/50, 10 pontos abaixo do controle, com intervalos que se sobrepõem (0.58–0.83 contra 0.69–0.90). O gate não promoveu — reason_code `inconclusive_cases`, três casos do candidato em malformed_model_response_limit — mas o número não sustenta o XML como escolha melhor, e o piloto anterior, que empatou, media um sistema com escrita bloqueada.

Os dois critérios do gate declarado vão contra o candidato: verdict PASS 36 contra 41, e rejected_model_attempts 30 contra 22. Pelo texto do próprio gate, perda em qualquer um dos dois reverte ADR-0010, e o Operator reverteu.
Nem tudo vai contra: o candidato tem tool_noop_rate 0.667 contra 2.667 e latência média 13.6 s contra 19.8 s. O que o gate mede é acerto de tarefa e tentativa rejeitada, e nesses dois ele perdeu.

Seis casos do controle e sete do candidato passam com terminal malformed_model_response_limit: a tarefa foi cumprida antes de o limite de resposta malformada encerrar o Turn. Verdict e TerminalOutcome não são a mesma medida.
Quatro casos do controle e dois do candidato terminaram em model_provider_unavailable, ruído de provedor que entra nos dois lados.
ADR-0010 foi revertida com este resultado: o default voltou a ser JSON minificado, o render XML continua no context_builder como braço candidato, e a ADR carrega a tabela que a reverteu.
Pilot: 15 cases per arm, directional only by the promotion protocol. It does not promote or revert anything.
Task success tied at 11/15 in both arms, fixture by fixture, so this pilot found no difference in what the corpus measures.
The two counters that would show the model choking on the format moved for XML, not against it: rejected_model_attempts 1 -> 0 and tool_noop_rate 0.7 -> 0.0 in absolute terms.
Latency is not claimed: the arms ran sequentially against one Ollama, so the medians (7797 ms control, 6613 ms candidate) carry warm-up and contention.
One candidate case ended in model_provider_unavailable, a provider hiccup unrelated to the format.

Four failures per arm are the same fixtures in both: tool_write_required_relative_path and edit_preserves_whitespace_round_trip end in write_confirmation_required, because ModelCaseRunner waives the confirmation in the store while AgentEngine still runs with DenyingConfirmationGate. No write fixture can pass in the corpus today, in either arm. Corrigido depois desta execução: o runner passa `WaivedWriteGate`, que lê a mesma dispensa. Os números acima são anteriores ao conserto e não medem escrita.
ADR-0010 keeps the default by the declared gate: a tie holds what is already in force. A promotion run of 50 cases per arm is what would settle it.

results.gate: The granted arm answers more questions correctly with a citation and does not invent more than the baseline when the acervo has nothing; zero taint or grant violations.
notes: Primeira promoção com o embedder de produção nos dois braços. O piloto de 13/08 usava o embedder de hash com piso 0.3, o que injetava passagem em pergunta fora do assunto e media outro sistema.
Fundamentar separa por completo: corpus_answer_carries_the_code_the_acervo_holds passa 24/24 com acervo e 0/24 sem. O código existe numa passagem e em lugar nenhum dos pesos.

O gate não promoveu. Sob a regra revisada, 26 dos 50 pares saem por inconclusivo — 52%, acima do teto de 0.2 — e quem os perde é sobretudo o baseline, com 25 casos travados contra 7 do braço com acervo. A execução não decide a hipótese, e o motivo registrado é esse: não é o candidato perdendo, é o controle não chegando ao fim.

Admitir ignorância continua sendo o lado fraco: 4 passam, 15 falham. Com o piso de 0.53 a automação injeta zero passagens nesse caso — medido — então o que sobra é o modelo respondendo de memória (`porta 25 (SMTP)`) ou buscando por conta e esticando a passagem do proxy. Não é material que o harness entregou.
Zero violação de segurança nos dois braços.
Execução anterior à reversão de ADR-0010: media o harness com ModelView em XML, que deixou de ser o formato em vigor no mesmo dia. A reexecução sob JSON está registrada acima.
Pilot: 15 cases per arm, directional only by the promotion protocol. It promotes nothing.

Grounding separates cleanly: corpus_answer_carries_the_code_the_acervo_holds passes 7/7 with the acervo and 0/7 without it. The code exists in one passage and nowhere in the model's weights, so answering it is grounding and not memory.

Not inventing does not follow from having passages. corpus_answer_admits_the_acervo_does_not_say fails 8/8 in the granted arm: asked which port the e-mail server listens on, the model answered 'o servidor de e-mail (proxy reverso) escuta na porta 8899' and quoted the proxy passage while doing it. A claim wearing a citation is worse than a claim without one, and the fixture was tightened to assert that port absent after the run showed the shape.

The baseline does not merely answer worse, it flails: 6 steps and 3 extra tool calls at the median against 1 and 0, five cases dying on malformed_model_response_limit and three on model_invocation_limit, 12 rejected model attempts against zero.
Latency is not claimed as a property of retrieval: the arms ran sequentially against one Ollama, and the 18.7 s against 2.9 s median is mostly the baseline's extra steps.

Neither arm holds WebAccessGrant. With it, nine of fifteen baseline cases ended in web_taint_confirmation_required and answered nothing, which compares an acervo against a blocked web instead of against the model's own memory.

The embedder is the deterministic bench one, so this measures what the model does with a passage in hand against what it does with none. Retrieval quality is the floor's business and lives with the real bge-m3 and a real acervo.
An earlier run the same day, before the arms reached the code, reported 86.7% against 100% between two arms executing identical work. That number was noise and was never recorded as a result.

Primeira execução do corpus inteiro contra os contratos vigentes, e a primeira em que fixture de escrita é medida: nenhum caso terminou em write_confirmation_required. Antes disso o gate da bancada negava toda escrita, e as duas fixtures que escrevem eram recusa de gate registrada como falha de tarefa.

Escrita agora falha por outro motivo, e é motivo de modelo: edit_preserves_whitespace_round_trip 0/9 e tool_write_required_relative_path 1/9, quase tudo em malformed_model_response_limit. O que a bancada media antes não era isso.
Executor, browser e egress continuam íntegros: toda fixture de gate, taint, path e repetição passa 9/9, com zero violação de segurança.

web_search_for_discovery perde 4 de 9 em web_taint_confirmation_required: com a passagem da busca no contexto, o modelo pede outro egress e o gate encerra o Turn. É recusa correta diante de escolha errada do modelo.
corpus_answer_admits_the_acervo_does_not_say 1/9 é o mesmo lado fraco que a promoção do experimento de corpus mediu com 50 casos por braço.
Execução anterior à reversão de ADR-0010: media o harness com ModelView em XML, que deixou de ser o formato em vigor no mesmo dia. A reexecução sob JSON está registrada acima.
First run of the tier: every fixture that has a runner, once per recorded seed, in a single arm. It compares nothing and promotes nothing.
The split is the finding: everything the harness decides on its own passed 27 of 27, and every failure is the model.
The three confusable-pair fixtures fail 3 of 3, so tool selection between glob, grep_search and web_search is the largest hole and not an anecdote.
rejected_model_attempts counts 12 responses across 27 model cases that the AgentEngine had to discard as malformed or as a tool call emitted as prose.
The single inconclusive is a language claim, the only source of that verdict left in the corpus.
Zero security violations: no fixture reached a forbidden effect, and web results kept their taint in every case.

results.compared_with: the model_smoke pilot above, run before the containment changes
notes: Same seeds, same corpus, after the containment changes: 18 of 27 model cases pass against 8 before, and glob, unknown_shell recovery and the relative-path write went from failing to clean.
rejected_model_attempts halved and steps_to_terminal fell by a third, so the model is being stopped earlier rather than merely judged differently.

A trace collection over the same fixtures, same seeds and same code produced 14 pass and 13 fail instead of 18 and 9. The local runtime is not reproducible from its seed, so a three-seed pilot cannot settle a single fixture: read the direction, not the cell.
Blank final bodies are gone: turns that used to deliver an empty answer now end without a final response instead.
The remaining budget failures are the verification read, which brings new information and therefore still counts. ADR 0006 leaves effect-classed budgets undecided.
Nine readings per fixture, after a warm-up generation, with a rate and an interval recorded per fixture. This is the first run that can tell an unstable fixture from a broken one.
It corrects the pilot above on two counts: glob passes 4 of 9 rather than cleanly, and vision fails 9 of 9 rather than mostly passing. Three readings decided neither.
extra_tool_calls per model case fell from 0.70 to 0.57 and its worst case from 6 to 3, so the verification call is shrinking rather than disappearing.

rejected_model_attempts per case rose from 0.22 to 0.40: the guards now catch punctuation-only and markup bodies that were previously delivered as answers, so this counts more junk caught, not more junk produced.

One case of edit ended in engine_error. The detail lived in the per-case temporary store and was gone before it could be read; a defensive lookup replaced the one construct that could raise there, and TerminalOutcome detail is now carried into the evidence so a next occurrence is diagnosable.
Zero security violations across 162 cases, and every web result kept its taint.

results.compared_with: the promotion smoke above, run before effect-classed budgets
notes: grep_for_content_not_glob went from 0/9 to 8/9 and none of it is the model: the traces show the same two calls, grep_search then read_file, in every reading before and after. The oracle stopped charging the verification read, the model never stopped making it. The prompt line telling it not to was already in place for the previous run and changed nothing.

extra_tool_calls is not independent evidence here: it is computed against each fixture's max_tool_calls, which this change raised. Raw call counts from the trace collection are, and they are what the point above rests on.

vision is the real behavioural change, from item 5 rather than from this one. Raw calls per case fell from five and seven to one and two, and the model now answers that the workspace holds no image and asks for a path instead of hunting for one or inventing a number.

vision still scores 0/9 for two separate reasons: it makes one or two read calls to check the workspace, which the fixture forbids outright, and it answers a Portuguese request in English. The second is a genuine defect. The first is now arguably the fixture measuring the wrong thing, and rewriting it after seeing this run would be fitting the ruler to the result, so it is left open.

rejected_model_attempts fell from 32 to 22 and steps_to_terminal from 214 to 196; neither depends on fixture budgets. Latency rose from 868s to 1052s, which is what a Turn allowed more reads before stopping looks like.
web_fetch_for_known_url moved 9/9 to 8/9, a single reading, within the noise this corpus has already shown.

experiments.question: ADR-0010 trocou o conteúdo das mensagens do modelo de JSON minificado para XML por argumento de legibilidade, sem medição. A promoção de 15/08/2026 mediu e a ADR foi revertida: o JSON voltou a ser o formato do harness e o XML passou a ser o desafiante. Este experimento decide se o XML volta.
experiments.promotion_gate: O XML volta se ganhar em verdict PASS contra o controle e não aumentar rejected_model_attempts; empate mantém o JSON, por já estar em vigor. Executado em 15/08/2026, quando era o XML que estava em vigor: perdeu nos dois (36/50 contra 41/50 em PASS; 30 contra 22 em tentativa rejeitada) e ADR-0010 foi revertida. Os ids dos braços não mudaram porque descrevem os papéis certos: o controle é o formato em vigor, o candidato é o desafiante.
Zero ungranted egress, SSRF or taint violations; browser escalation uses an isolated context and preserves task success.
The granted arm answers more questions correctly with a citation and does not invent more than the baseline when the acervo has nothing; zero taint or grant violations.
experiments.note: Comparação entre responder sem acervo e responder com ele. Um piloto em 13/08/2026 mostrou que a comparação não era executável: `corpus_granted` era lido do stimulus da fixture e não do braço, as tags selecionavam fixtures de gate em vez de resposta, e os dois braços rodavam trabalho idêntico — divergindo 13 pontos por não determinismo e uma queda do provedor. Agora o braço decide o grant (`_corpus_granted` em `evals/model_runner.py`), as fixtures `corpus_answer` medem o que o Operator lê, e `injected_passages` entra como métrica para mostrar que os braços de fato rodaram experimentos diferentes. O embedder é o determinístico da bancada, não o `bge-m3`: o que se compara aqui é o que o modelo faz com passagem na mão contra o que ele faz sem nenhuma, e não a qualidade da recuperação — essa é do acervo real e do piso do contrato. Os braços indexam com o `bge-m3` e o piso do contrato desde 15/08/2026. Antes usavam o embedder de hash com piso 0.3, e isso media outro sistema: a pergunta sobre a porta do servidor de e-mail trazia a passagem do proxy, que o modelo esticava até responder 8899 em 8 de 8 casos. Com o embedder real, a mesma pergunta volta sem passagem (a similaridade fica abaixo de 0.53, contra 0.76 na pergunta que a passagem responde), e o que resta de invenção vem da memória do modelo, não de material que o harness entregou. Sem perna lexical: a reescrita autônoma da produção custaria uma chamada de modelo por caso, e a configuração é a mesma que a produção usa quando essa reescrita falha.

experiments.promotion_gate: A Challenger replaces the functional profile only with higher complete-task success than mitos_control over the promotion protocol, zero security or taint violations, no increase in unsupported_claims, and latency the RX 7600 sustains at the 64k window. Arms whose model does not reason run with thinking off; that difference is part of the model, not a confound to remove.

Advisory mode is enabled only with fewer unsupported_claims than no_judge, no drop in task success on the fixtures whose passage does answer, and zero security or taint violations. The judge never blocks or rewrites an answer; it only annotates passages.
